actual_resolution_note: The built-in Imagegen tool returned native 1254 × 1254 PNGs. No upsampling or pixel editing was performed.

provenance.post_processing: none; original Imagegen PNG bytes. Project copies were made before executor interruption; Git blobs were then created directly from the preserved original data URI.

color_usage.limitations: Artist-directed generated colors, not measured spectral reflectance. These files do not include normal, roughness, metallic, height, ambient-occlusion or emission maps. Shader properties and physical scale remain integration choices.

tiling.intent: repeat in both U and V
tiling.note: Prompts request repeating edges. Opposite edges are not algorithmically equalized. All eight exact 2×2 repetition previews were visually reviewed. This review does not prove mathematical periodicity.

Avoid: objects, scenery, sample spheres, labels, text, numbers, logos, watermarks, frames, dramatic cracks, rubble, blood, photographic depth of field.
Subject: salt-weathered architectural concrete, a 2 by 2 meter area of an unjointed wall. Slight irregular tonal variation, restrained premium brutalist coastal architecture, light recent dust. No formwork seams, no rebar, no large holes. All surface relief should be communicated only by intrinsic material color variation, not directional shading.

visual_review.observation_fr: Béton greige salin homogène, sans source lumineuse directionnelle visible. Répétition 2×2 inspectée : les taches minérales se répètent perceptiblement, sans joint de couleur fortement contrasté à cette échelle.

quality_review.review_method: Each original image was displayed and inspected; exact 2×2 repeats were assembled with ImageMagick as temporary QA previews only. Asset pixels were never edited.
quality_review.byte_integrity_method: Decode the stored data URI, inspect PNG signature/IHDR, validate every PNG chunk CRC32 and complete IEND, compute SHA256. SHA256 implementation checked against the empty-string standard digest and the independent local SHA256 measurements for salt_concrete and smoked_oak.
quality_review.repeated_image_preview_storage: Temporary QA only; not part of the asset pack.

local_git_verification.method: After executor recovery: Pillow verify and full pixel decode, SHA256 of every project PNG, git hash-object, and git ls-tree HEAD compared with the recorded original hashes.
